entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So, I bought a mini roaster and[n]a coffee mill the other day...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I thought it would be fun[n]making coffee myself.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's certainly not easy, but it's[n]an immensely satisfying process...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Nnh...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Sorry about that... I just got a[n]little dizzy for a second there...
You look exhausted.
Don't overwork yourself.
Let's go see the nurse.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm fine, honestly...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Let's see, next up is... dirt for the[n]planters...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Ah...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think I just need to rest a little...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: To be honest, I haven't been[n]getting a lot of sleep lately...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Takakura-san has really been[n]pushing for us to start a new[n]business venture soon...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: In particular, he's adamant about a[n]chain of low-cost, intimate cafés.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Some employees don't think it's a[n]good idea though, so they want me[n]to step in and put a stop to it...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I'm just a high schooler...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: There's no way I could predict the[n]success or failure of this idea...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: In the end, I'm just not sure what to do...
That sounds really tough...
You should ask some employees.
What do you want to do?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It is... People simply won't stop[n]offering their opinions to me...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I never imagined how difficult life[n]could be in a position of power...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This must have been why my father[n]was so busy all the time...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: There's no need to ask. They tell me[n]what they think whether I want them[n]to or not. So many opinions...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I never imagined how difficult life[n]could be in a position of power...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This must have been why my father[n]was so busy all the time...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: H-Huh...? That's a good question...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The idea does sound nice...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The smell of a fresh cup of coffee[n]always brings a smile to my face.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And it certainly would be nice to[n]be able to give that experience[n]to as many people as possible...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But... I don't think you can truly[n]gain the same joy from the low-cost[n]chain Takakura-san is suggesting.
What does Takakura-san think?[clr 27]
There has to be a way.[clr 27]
You should tell him that.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I... I guess I never asked.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We only ever discuss things like[n]the budget or profit margins...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Maybe I should talk to him.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you honestly believe so...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was so convinced that the two[n]ideas were contradictory... but it[n]might just be possible after all.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Maybe I should talk to him.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You really think he'd listen[n]to a high schooler with no[n]prior work experience...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hm, I see...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've been so afraid of him this[n]whole time... but all I need to[n]do is show him how I feel...!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'll make him see what I'm[n]really thinking... and what's[n]truly important to me.
That's the spirit.[clr 27]
You can do it, Haru.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I understand...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: By refusing to trust Takakura-san,[n]I was also shutting myself off from[n]any hope of having him trust me...!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But that's going to be different[n]now... I'll do my best, [fName]-kun!
I can sense a strong[n]resolve from Haru...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Oh, and I just thought of[n]the perfect way to do it!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: A magic item that will help me convey[n]my true feelings to Takakura-san...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* It's going to take some[n]time to prepare though, so it will[n]have to be my secret for now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I'll tell you next time, okay?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now then, shall we return home?
